notes.text: Early strace-only recording missed syscalls past strace tables under keeper processes and struggled with io_uring race windows.

commits.title: Launch public Smithers Cloud factory with Lighthouse audit, Cloud MCP, and 3-audience UI

notes.text: Initial GitHub Actions workflow checked secrets inside step-level if expressions and passed empty strings to process.env, causing early CI failures before moving secret guards into env-checked shell branches.

commits.title: Remediate all 14 root-input security findings, atomic PKCE exchange, and live Markdown Wiki Docs

notes.text: Root-input security audit flagged async PKCE race windows, attenuated artifact scope elevation, untrusted CAS sharing, symlink traversal, and missing DO SQLite migration for waitlist deduplication. Live browser QA also exposed stale asset SPA fallback MIME mismatches and HTML-vs-Markdown rendering on smithers.sh Docs.

Closed all 14 findings with atomic SQLite transactionSync PKCE burn (verified 1/10 success and 9/10 401 under concurrent live edge load), untrusted-cas/ isolation with quotas, commit-bound GateReceipts, 1,000+ fuzz tests, zero-JS CSS-filtered Lighthouse HTML, ReplayEngine CLI, URL deep-linking, and live /wiki/*.md serving.
